name: Intangimere
description: Intangimere is a place that's a bit hard to grasp. Time forgets to hurry. Death knocks as a courtesy. Fate loses the thread of the conversation. The question isn't - is anyone home? The question is - did they ever live there at all?

name: Dramaside
tagline: Everyone's got something to say about it
description: Nobody moves to Dramaside by accident. They audition. The streets are loud, the neighbors are louder, and someone is always watching from behind that fence. Every argument is a performance. Every reconciliation deserves applause.

name: Achey Hollow
tagline: It's quiet here. Come sit a spell
description: The neighborhood where all the residents have lost one thing or another. The lights seem dimmer. Where silence has settled in. But everyone who lives there knows - one day, they'll find what they lost, the lights will get brighter, and the laughter will fill the vacancies.

name: Gimmewood
description: More.More. That's the only word anyone in Gimmewood knows. More stars. More trees with things carved in them. More of whatever you just had. The street smells like want and fresh wood shavings. Nobody's unhappy here. Nobody's finished either.

name: Weirdford
description: Nobody planned to cross the bridge into Weirdford. Nobody plans anything in Weirdford. Your body just does a thing — hiccups, sneezes, shivers for no reason — and suddenly you're here. The bridge is slightly wrong. The houses lean. Don't worry. It passes. Probably.

description: Not every block is ready for visitors. Some hoods are still figuring out who lives there. The lights are on. The porch is swept. Somebody's moving in soon. Mind the dust.
